mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 3.0% (t-test p > 0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in housing starts (HOUST < 1400) and industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicates a broad-based economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1400 and INDPRO < 100 (t-test p > 0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: An annual CPIAUCSL change exceeding 5.0% signals persistent inflation, triggering aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL annual change > 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales exceeding 700,000 million dollars indicates robust consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 700000 (t-test p > 0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing profit expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 (t-test p > 0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous labor market strength (PAYEMS > 158000) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) indicate a healthy economic environment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market strength with accommodative policy
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 158000 and FEDFUNDS < 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, GDP growth exceeding 2.0% annualized (GDPC1) signals sustained economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when the regime is late-cycle expansion (t-test p > 0.05 vs. baseline).
